entries.question: Q1
entries.citation: Male CNS connectome v1.0 type pages (Janelia FlyEM, male-cns.janelia.org), with Berg S et al. (2026) Sexual dimorphism in the complete Drosophila male central nervous system connectome. Cell 189:5504 (bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.10.09.680999)
entries.summary: Each male CNS type page carries an "Across-brain Mapping" label and a "MANC Type" field (per type), e.g. ANXXX116 -> MANC Type ANXXX116. The preprint figure legend (read only as a tool summary) describes matching by spatial transforms + NBLAST and connectivity co-clustering. Whether every male CNS VNC name equals its MANC name is not stated; each mapped type would need its own page checked.

check.note: confirmed on the ANXXX116 type page: "Across-brain Mapping" field defined as mapping between male CNS and FlyWire or MANC; "MANC Type: ANXXX116"; dataset male-cns:v1.0 (root page: v1.0 released 2026-06-08). The IN13B001 type page returned HTTP 404, so the field was confirmed on one page only; the preprint matching method was not part of the check.

entries.method: per-type MANC Type field on dataset documentation pages; matching method stated only in a part of the preprint read as summary

entries.question: Q5
entries.citation: Chen C, Agrawal S, Mark B, et al., Tuthill JC (2021) Functional architecture of neural circuits for leg proprioception in Drosophila. Curr Biol 31:5163-5175
entries.summary: Optogenetic activation of FeCO subtypes with two-photon calcium imaging of second-order classes (adult female). Subtype-specific pairs: club -> 9Ba (excitation), club -> 10Ba (excitation), claw (extension) -> 13Bb (excitation), hook (extension) -> 13Bb, hook (flexion) -> 8Aa, club -> 9Bb only with picrotoxin. Pairs reported only for pooled "claw" (13Ba, 8Aa, 8Ba, 19Aa, 19Ab, 20/22Ab) are not listed because the protocol targets name claw subtypes.

check.note: confirmed: club -> 9Ba and 10Ba (P14, P20, P26); 13Bb responds to extension-tuned claw, not flexion-tuned (P32, Fig. 4D) and to hook (extension) (P14); 8Aa to claw and hook (flexion) (P14); 9Bb only with picrotoxin (P34, Fig. 5A); 9Bb/9Agamma naming inconsistent within the paper

entries.method: optogenetics (Chrimson) + GCaMP6 two-photon imaging; MLA and picrotoxin pharmacology

entries.question: Q5
entries.citation: Pratt BG, Dallmann CJ, Chou GM, et al., Tuthill JC (2026) Proprioceptive limit detectors contribute to sensorimotor control of the Drosophila leg. Nat Commun 17:2664
entries.summary: Calcium imaging of CxHP8 hair plate axons during passive leg movement; optogenetic activation and silencing read out behaviour; targets identified in FANC by hemilineage and motor module, no MANC or male CNS names (MANC hair plate axons too poorly reconstructed). No paired stimulus/recording of identified cells; hair plates are outside the declared targets.

check.note: confirmed: CxHP8 axon calcium imaging during passive movement; optogenetics read out as kinematics; reconstruction in FANC because hair plate axons could not be identified in MANC; no recording of downstream neurons. Wording note: MANC is named as a dataset; no MANC or male CNS type names for hair plates were seen.

entries.method: calcium imaging (afferent only), optogenetics with behavioural readout, FANC reconstruction
